# CoinVello API: complete integration guide for AI assistants

> This single document is enough to integrate CoinVello end to end. It follows the llms.txt convention
> (https://llmstxt.org). The short index is at https://coinvello.com/llms.txt; the machine-readable
> OpenAPI 3.1 reference is at https://coinvello.com/.well-known/openapi.yaml. Version 2026-10-01.

## 0. What CoinVello is (say this correctly)

CoinVello (https://coinvello.com) is a **non-custodial crypto payment processor** for online merchants.

- **Non-custodial.** Payments go directly from the payer's wallet to an address the merchant controls.
  For Bitcoin the merchant registers an **xpub** and CoinVello derives a fresh receiving
  address per invoice. For Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon, BNB Chain, Avalanche, Robinhood
  Chain, Solana and Tron the merchant registers an **address they own**. CoinVello never holds crypto or fiat, so
  there is no balance, no payout and no withdrawal step: the money is already in the merchant's wallet.
- **No KYC, no KYB.** Signup is an email address and an API key. The API collects no identity data
  about merchants or payers. The only verification that can ever happen is on a third-party partner's
  side if the merchant chooses to connect an off-ramp account (optional).
- **Fees are prepaid processing credits, bought in crypto.** No percentage cut, no per-transaction
  cents. 1 credit = $0.01 nominal. Each confirmed payment consumes roughly 30 bps of its fiat value
  (floor 2 credits, cap 2,000 credits). Bundles get cheaper per credit with volume, giving an
  effective rate of ~0.30% (Starter) down to under 0.10% (Enterprise). There are no free live
  credits; an account that does not want to prepay uses **pay as you go** (0.4% split on-chain,
  open to every account, section 3b). Test mode credits cost nothing and never run out. Live prices come
  from `GET /credits/bundles`.
- **11 networks**: bitcoin, ethereum, base, arbitrum, optimism, polygon, bnb, avalanche,
  robinhood, solana, tron. Assets: native coins plus USDC (ethereum, base, arbitrum, optimism, polygon,
  bnb, avalanche, solana), USDT (ethereum, base, arbitrum, optimism, polygon, bnb, avalanche, solana, tron),
  DAI (ethereum, base, arbitrum, optimism, polygon), EURC (ethereum, base, avalanche, solana), PYUSD
  (ethereum) and USDG (`usdg:robinhood`, Paxos Global Dollar, on Robinhood Chain, EVM chain id 4663).
  Bitcoin tokens (not stablecoins, priced at the BTC rate): WBTC (ethereum, base, arbitrum, optimism,
  polygon), cbBTC (ethereum, base, arbitrum, solana), BTCB (`btcb:bnb`, 18 decimals) and BTC.b
  (`btcb:avalanche`). Tokens without an official testnet contract are live-only (absent from test mode):
  DAI, `usdc:bnb` (Binance-Peg, 18 decimals), USDT on base, arbitrum (USD₮0), optimism, avalanche and
  solana, and every Bitcoin token (`wbtc:*`, `cbbtc:*`, `btcb:*`).
- **Integration surfaces**: hosted checkout (pay.coinvello.com), embeddable widget
  (`@coinvello/checkout`), REST API with SDKs (`@coinvello/sdk` on npm; `coinvello/sdk` and `coinvello` hosted at
  https://coinvello.com/downloads/sdk/ until the Packagist and PyPI releases), plugins (WooCommerce available now; Shopify pending Shopify's approval; Magento 2, PrestaShop, OpenCart in testing),
  MCP server (`@coinvello/mcp`).

## 1. Conventions

```
Base URL        https://api.coinvello.com/v1
Auth            Authorization: Bearer cv_test_...  (test mode)  |  cv_live_...  (live mode)
Content type    application/json (UTF-8)
Idempotency     Idempotency-Key: <unique string, <= 255 chars> on every POST (replayed for 24 h)
Version pin     CoinVello-Version: 2026-10-01 (optional)
Amounts         decimal STRINGS, e.g. "49.99", "0.00074230". Never floats.
Asset ids       "<asset>:<chain>", e.g. "btc:bitcoin", "eth:ethereum", "usdc:polygon", "usdt:tron", "sol:solana"
Ids             inv_ (invoice) pay_ (payment) wal_ (wallet) whe_ (webhook endpoint) evt_ (event)
                cs_ (checkout session) cpu_ (credit purchase) rf_ (refund) cnv_ (conversion) ofp_ (off-ramp payout)
Lists           GET ...?limit=20&cursor=<next_cursor>  ->  { "object": "list", "data": [...], "has_more": true, "next_cursor": "..." }
Errors          { "error": { "type", "code", "message", "param?", "request_id", "doc_url?", "details?" } }
Rate limit      100 req/s per key (burst 200); 429 carries Retry-After
Local mock      http://localhost:4242/v1  (api/reference-server, accepts any cv_test_ key)
```

Test mode is a separate universe: test wallets, invoices, webhooks and credits are invisible to live
keys and vice versa. Test-mode chains map to testnet4, sepolia, base-sepolia,
arbitrum-sepolia, optimism-sepolia, amoy, bnb-testnet, fuji,
robinhood-testnet (chain id 46630), devnet, nile.

Key types: `cv_test_` / `cv_live_` (full merchant keys), `cv_test_rk_` / `cv_live_rk_` (restricted
keys with scopes such as `invoices:write checkout_sessions:write webhooks:write events:read`).
Merchants copy keys from Settings -> API keys (behind a second-factor check); keep them server-side only. Never put an API key in client-side code.

## 2. The recommended integration in five steps

1. Register a wallet (`POST /wallets`) - once, usually from the dashboard. It is usable at once in
   live and test mode; addresses are validated strictly; a signed-message proof is optional.
2. Create a **checkout session** (`POST /checkout-sessions`) when the customer wants to pay.
3. **Redirect** the customer to `session.url` (`https://pay.coinvello.com/c/cs_...`). The hosted page
   shows asset choice, QR code, wallet buttons, live status, and redirects to `success_url`.
4. Create a **webhook endpoint** (`POST /webhooks`) once; on each delivery verify
   `CoinVello-Signature`, dedupe on `event.id`, and **fulfil the order on `invoice.paid`**.
5. In test mode, trigger the whole pipeline with `POST /test/simulate_payment`.

Fulfil from webhooks (or by re-fetching the invoice with your API key), never from the redirect:
the redirect URL can be opened by anyone.

### 2.1 Register a wallet

Bitcoin (xpub; a fresh address per invoice):

```bash
curl https://api.coinvello.com/v1/wallets \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $COINVELLO_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"type":"xpub","chain":"bitcoin","label":"Shop BTC","xpub":"vpub5Y6cjg7...","derivation_path":"m/84'"'"'/1'"'"'/0'"'"'"}'
```

EVM / Solana / Tron (merchant-owned address):

```bash
curl https://api.coinvello.com/v1/wallets \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $COINVELLO_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"type":"address","chain":"polygon","label":"Polygon hot wallet","address":"0x8ba1f109551bD432803012645Ac136ddd64DBA72","assets":["usdc:polygon","usdt:polygon"]}'
```

`WalletCreateRequest` fields: `type` (xpub|address, required), `chain` (required), `label` (required),
`xpub`, `derivation_path` (e.g. `m/84'/0'/0'`), `address_type` (p2pkh|p2sh-p2wpkh|p2wpkh|p2tr),
`start_index`, `address`, `assets[]`, `enabled`, `metadata`. Response: `Wallet` with `id` (`wal_`),
`status` (active|verified|archived; `unverified` is a legacy synonym of active), `assets[]`,
`first_address` (xpub wallets: compare it with the wallet's first receive address), and
`verification.status` (`not_required` by default; signing a challenge is optional). Never send an xprv:
it is rejected with `422 xprv_rejected` and you must rotate it. Bad addresses (wrong checksum, wrong
network, zero/burn address, a token contract) are refused with `422 address_invalid`; Bitcoin
needs an xpub (`422 xpub_required`).

### 2.2 Create a checkout session

```bash
curl https://api.coinvello.com/v1/checkout-sessions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $COINVELLO_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "Idempotency-Key: order-8812-checkout" \
  -d '{
    "amount": "129.00",
    "currency": "EUR",
    "accepted_assets": ["btc:bitcoin", "eth:ethereum", "usdt:tron", "usdc:polygon"],
    "order_id": "SHOP-8812",
    "success_url": "https://shop.example.com/thanks?order=8812",
    "cancel_url": "https://shop.example.com/cart",
    "customer": { "email": "buyer@example.com" },
    "line_items": [{ "name": "Mechanical keyboard", "quantity": 1, "unit_amount": "129.00" }],
    "redirect_on": "confirming",
    "metadata": { "order_id": "8812" }
  }'
```

Response `201 CheckoutSession`:

```json
{
  "id": "cs_5TgH8kLp2Q",
  "object": "checkout_session",
  "livemode": false,
  "status": "open",
  "url": "https://pay.coinvello.com/c/cs_5TgH8kLp2Q",
  "invoice_id": "inv_9XyZ12AbC3",
  "invoice_status": "new",
  "amount": "129.00",
  "currency": "EUR",
  "order_id": "SHOP-8812",
  "success_url": "https://shop.example.com/thanks?order=8812",
  "cancel_url": "https://shop.example.com/cart",
  "redirect_on": "confirming",
  "expires_at": "2026-10-21T10:30:00Z",
  "created_at": "2026-10-21T10:00:00Z"
}
```

`CheckoutSessionCreateRequest` = every `InvoiceCreateRequest` field plus `success_url` (required),
`line_items[]` (`name`, `quantity`, `unit_amount`, `description?`, `image_url?`), `redirect_on`
(`confirming` default | `paid`), `locale`, `branding` (`theme` light|dark|auto, `logo_url`,
`primary_color` `#RRGGBB`, `merchant_name`), `collect_email`, `allow_asset_change`.

`InvoiceCreateRequest` fields: `amount` (required, decimal string), `currency` (required; ISO 4217
such as USD/EUR/GBP or an asset id such as `btc:bitcoin` to price in crypto), `accepted_assets[]`
(defaults to all eligible), `order_id` (<=128, indexed), `description`, `customer`
(`email`, `name`, `reference`), `success_url`, `cancel_url`, `expires_in` (300..86400 s, default 1800),
`rate_lock` (default true), `rate_lock_id`, `required_confirmations` (per asset override),
`underpayment_tolerance` (default "0.005"), `overpayment_tolerance` (default "0.02"),
`payment_options_mode` (all|single), `metadata` (<=50 string pairs).

Checkout session `status`: `open` -> `complete` | `expired`. The underlying invoice carries the money
state: `new -> pending -> confirming -> paid`, or `underpaid`, `overpaid`, `expired`, `cancelled`,
`refund_requested`. Alias path `/checkout_sessions` is accepted. `GET /checkout-sessions/{id}?expand=invoice`
embeds the invoice. `POST /checkout-sessions/{id}/expire` closes it.

Public, unauthenticated, CORS-open endpoints used by the hosted page and widget (never need your key):
`GET /checkout-sessions/{id}/public` (redacted `PublicCheckoutSession`) and
`GET /checkout-sessions/{id}/events` (Server-Sent Events: `status` on every change, `heartbeat` every 15 s).

### 2.3 Or create a bare invoice (bring your own UI)

```bash
curl https://api.coinvello.com/v1/invoices \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $COINVELLO_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "Idempotency-Key: order-10042-invoice" \
  -d '{"amount":"49.99","currency":"USD","accepted_assets":["btc:bitcoin","usdc:polygon"],"order_id":"WC-10042","success_url":"https://shop.example.com/thanks","metadata":{"woocommerce_order_id":"10042"}}'
```

Response `201 Invoice` (abridged):

```json
{
  "id": "inv_9XyZ12AbC3",
  "object": "invoice",
  "livemode": false,
  "status": "new",
  "amount": "49.99",
  "currency": "USD",
  "pricing": "fiat",
  "accepted_assets": ["btc:bitcoin", "usdc:polygon"],
  "hosted_url": "https://pay.coinvello.com/i/inv_9XyZ12AbC3",
  "payment_options": [
    {
      "asset": "btc:bitcoin", "symbol": "BTC", "chain": "bitcoin", "network_id": null,
      "address": "tb1qw508d6qejxtdg4y5r3zarvary0c5xw7kxpjzsx",
      "amount": "0.00074230", "amount_minor": "74230", "rate": "67350.12",
      "payment_uri": "bitcoin:tb1qw508d6qejxtdg4y5r3zarvary0c5xw7kxpjzsx?amount=0.0007423",
      "qr_payload": "bitcoin:tb1qw508d6qejxtdg4y5r3zarvary0c5xw7kxpjzsx?amount=0.0007423",
      "required_confirmations": 1, "status": "available"
    },
    {
      "asset": "usdc:polygon", "symbol": "USDC", "chain": "polygon", "network_id": "80002",
      "address": "0x8ba1f109551bD432803012645Ac136ddd64DBA72",
      "contract_address": "0x41E94Eb019C0762f9Bfcf9Fb1E58725BfB0e7582", "decimals": 6,
      "amount": "50.000518", "amount_minor": "50000518", "rate": "0.9999",
      "payment_uri": "ethereum:0x41E94Eb019C0762f9Bfcf9Fb1E58725BfB0e7582@80002/transfer?address=0x8ba1f109551bD432803012645Ac136ddd64DBA72&uint256=50000518",
      "qr_payload": "ethereum:0x41E94Eb019C0762f9Bfcf9Fb1E58725BfB0e7582@80002/transfer?address=0x8ba1f109551bD432803012645Ac136ddd64DBA72&uint256=50000518",
      "required_confirmations": 64, "status": "available"
    }
  ],
  "paid": null,
  "order_id": "WC-10042",
  "rate_lock": { "locked": true, "locked_until": "2026-10-21T10:30:00Z", "rates": { "btc:bitcoin": "67350.12", "usdc:polygon": "0.9999" } },
  "metadata": { "woocommerce_order_id": "10042" },
  "expires_at": "2026-10-21T10:30:00Z",
  "created_at": "2026-10-21T10:00:00Z"
}
```

Render a QR from `qr_payload` and a wallet deep link from `payment_uri` (BIP-21 for BTC, EIP-681
for EVM, Solana Pay for Solana, `tron:` for Tron). Once a payment is detected, `invoice.paid`
(the object field) holds `amount_received`, `amount_remaining`, `confirmations`, `payment_ids`.
Other invoice endpoints: `GET /invoices?status=&order_id=&limit=&cursor=`, `GET /invoices/{id}`,
`PATCH /invoices/{id}` (metadata/description), `POST /invoices/{id}/cancel`, `POST /invoices/{id}/expire`,
`GET /invoices/{id}/payments`.

### 2.4 Create a webhook endpoint

```bash
curl https://api.coinvello.com/v1/webhooks \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $COINVELLO_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"url":"https://shop.example.com/webhooks/coinvello","description":"Shop production","events":["invoice.paid","invoice.confirming","invoice.underpaid","invoice.overpaid","invoice.expired","payment.detected","checkout_session.completed"]}'
```

Response `201 Webhook` includes `"secret": "whsec_<64 hex>"` **once**. Store it as `COINVELLO_WEBHOOK_SECRET`.
Live endpoints must be HTTPS; test endpoints may be `http://localhost`. Use `"events": ["*"]` for everything.
`POST /webhooks/{id}/test` sends a signed ping. `POST /webhooks/{id}/rotate_secret` rotates with a
grace period during which deliveries carry two `v1=` signatures. Up to 16 endpoints per mode.

Every delivery:

```
POST /webhooks/coinvello
Content-Type: application/json
User-Agent: CoinVello-Webhooks/1.0 (+https://coinvello.com/webhooks)
CoinVello-Signature: t=1760000000,v1=5257a869e7ecebeda32affa62cdca3fa51cad7e77a0e56ff536d0ce8e108d8bd
CoinVello-Event-Id: evt_1Nz7Qw3Er9
CoinVello-Event-Type: invoice.paid
CoinVello-Webhook-Id: whe_2JxK9vL3mQ
CoinVello-Delivery-Id: whd_4Hn7Pq2W
CoinVello-Delivery-Attempt: 1

{
  "id": "evt_1Nz7Qw3Er9",
  "object": "event",
  "type": "invoice.paid",
  "livemode": true,
  "api_version": "2026-10-01",
  "created_at": "2026-10-21T10:04:12Z",
  "data": {
    "object": { "id": "inv_9XyZ12AbC3", "object": "invoice", "status": "paid", "order_id": "WC-10042", "metadata": { "woocommerce_order_id": "10042" }, "...": "..." },
    "previous_attributes": { "status": "confirming" }
  },
  "request": { "id": "req_...", "idempotency_key": "order-10042-invoice" },
  "pending_webhooks": 1
}
```

Respond `2xx` within 10 s. Retries: 1 min, 5 min, 30 min, 2 h, 6 h, 12 h, 24 h, 24 h (9 attempts,
~70 h). Ordering is not guaranteed: act on `data.object.status`, not on the sequence of events.
Endpoints are `degraded` after 3 consecutive failures and auto-disabled after 72 h of failures.

Event types: `invoice.created`, `invoice.pending`, `invoice.confirming` (safe to show "payment
received"), `invoice.paid` (**fulfil**), `invoice.underpaid`, `invoice.overpaid`, `invoice.expired`,
`invoice.cancelled`, `invoice.refund_requested`, `payment.detected`, `payment.confirmed`,
`payment.failed`, `wallet.verified`, `checkout_session.completed`, `checkout_session.expired`,
`credits.low`, `credits.added`, `credits.purchase.paid` / `.underpaid` / `.expired`,
`refund.completed` / `.failed`, `conversion.completed` / `.failed`, `offramp.completed` / `.failed`.

### 2.5 Verify the webhook signature (exact scheme)

```
CoinVello-Signature: t=<unix seconds>,v1=<hex HMAC-SHA256>[,v1=<hex HMAC-SHA256>]
```

1. Read the **raw request body bytes** before any JSON/body-parser middleware touches them.
2. Parse the header into `t` and one or more `v1` values.
3. Reject if `t` is missing or `|now - t| > 300` seconds.
4. `expected = hex(HMAC_SHA256(key = secret as UTF-8 including the "whsec_" prefix, message = "<t>." + raw_body))`.
5. Compare `expected` against each `v1` with a constant-time comparison. Valid if any matches.
6. Dedupe on `event.id` (keep processed ids for at least 3 days). Only then parse JSON and act.

Node (no dependencies):

```js
import crypto from "node:crypto";

export function verifyCoinVelloSignature(rawBody, header, secret, toleranceSec = 300) {
  if (!header) throw new Error("missing CoinVello-Signature");
  let t = 0; const sigs = [];
  for (const part of header.split(",")) {
    const [k, ...rest] = part.trim().split("="); const v = rest.join("=");
    if (k === "t") t = Number(v);
    if (k === "v1") sigs.push(v);
  }
  if (!t || Math.abs(Date.now() / 1000 - t) > toleranceSec) throw new Error("timestamp outside tolerance");
  const body = Buffer.isBuffer(rawBody) ? rawBody : Buffer.from(rawBody, "utf8");
  const expected = crypto.createHmac("sha256", secret).update(`${t}.`).update(body).digest();
  const ok = sigs.some((s) => {
    const b = Buffer.from(s, "hex");
    return b.length === expected.length && crypto.timingSafeEqual(b, expected);
  });
  if (!ok) throw new Error("signature mismatch");
  return JSON.parse(body.toString("utf8"));
}
```

Python (stdlib only):

```python
import hmac, hashlib, json, time

def verify_coinvello_signature(raw_body: bytes, header: str, secret: str, tolerance: int = 300) -> dict:
    t, sigs = 0, []
    for part in (header or "").split(","):
        k, _, v = part.strip().partition("=")
        if k == "t":
            t = int(v)
        elif k == "v1":
            sigs.append(v)
    if not t or abs(time.time() - t) > tolerance:
        raise ValueError("timestamp outside tolerance")
    expected = hmac.new(secret.encode(), f"{t}.".encode() + raw_body, hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()
    if not any(hmac.compare_digest(expected, s) for s in sigs):
        raise ValueError("signature mismatch")
    return json.loads(raw_body)
```

PHP (plain, WordPress, Laravel):

```php
<?php
function coinvello_verify(string $raw, string $header, string $secret, int $tolerance = 300): array
{
    $t = 0; $sigs = [];
    foreach (explode(',', $header) as $pair) {
        $kv = explode('=', trim($pair), 2);
        if (count($kv) !== 2) continue;
        if ($kv[0] === 't')  { $t = (int) $kv[1]; }
        if ($kv[0] === 'v1') { $sigs[] = $kv[1]; }
    }
    if ($t === 0 || abs(time() - $t) > $tolerance) {
        throw new RuntimeException('timestamp outside tolerance');
    }
    $expected = hash_hmac('sha256', $t . '.' . $raw, $secret);
    foreach ($sigs as $sig) {
        if (hash_equals($expected, $sig)) {
            return json_decode($raw, true, 512, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);
        }
    }
    throw new RuntimeException('signature mismatch');
}
// $event = coinvello_verify(file_get_contents('php://input'), $_SERVER['HTTP_COINVELLO_SIGNATURE'] ?? '', getenv('COINVELLO_WEBHOOK_SECRET'));
```

With the SDKs: Node `cv.webhooks.constructEvent(rawBody, header, secret)`, PHP
`\CoinVello\Sdk\Webhooks::constructEvent($raw, $header, $secret)`, Python
`coinvello.Webhooks.construct_event(raw, header, secret)`. All throw on failure.

Test vector (useful for unit tests): secret `whsec_test`, `t = 1760000000`, body `{"id":"evt_1","type":"ping"}`
-> signed string `1760000000.{"id":"evt_1","type":"ping"}`; compute `v1` with the code above and
assert that changing one body byte fails.

### 2.6 Poll an invoice (fallback or reconciliation)

```bash
curl https://api.coinvello.com/v1/invoices/inv_9XyZ12AbC3 -H "Authorization: Bearer $COINVELLO_API_KEY"
curl "https://api.coinvello.com/v1/checkout-sessions/cs_5TgH8kLp2Q?expand=invoice" -H "Authorization: Bearer $COINVELLO_API_KEY"
curl "https://api.coinvello.com/v1/invoices?order_id=WC-10042" -H "Authorization: Bearer $COINVELLO_API_KEY"
```

Poll every 5 s while the status is non-terminal, backing off to 60 s on errors. Terminal statuses:
`paid`, `underpaid`, `overpaid`, `expired`, `cancelled`. For high-value flows re-fetch the invoice
with your API key before fulfilling, even after a verified webhook.

### 2.7 Simulate a payment in test mode

```bash
curl https://api.coinvello.com/v1/test/simulate_payment \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $COINVELLO_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"invoice_id":"inv_9XyZ12AbC3","asset":"usdc:polygon","confirmations":64}'
```

`SimulatePaymentRequest`: `invoice_id` (`inv_` or `cpu_`, required), `asset`, `amount` (less/more to
simulate underpaid/overpaid), `confirmations` (0 = detected only; >= required = confirmed),
`tx_hash` (reuse to advance the same payment), `from_address`, `delay_seconds` (0..300).
Test keys only (`403 test_mode_only` otherwise). It runs the real state machine and fires real
signed webhooks.

## 3. Credits (how fees work in the API)

```bash
curl https://api.coinvello.com/v1/credits/balance -H "Authorization: Bearer $COINVELLO_API_KEY"
# {"object":"credits_balance","livemode":true,"balance":1852,"available":1840,"reserved":12,"low_balance_threshold":200,
#  "estimated_payments_remaining":76,"auto_topup":{"enabled":true,"bundle_id":"bnd_growth_15000","trigger_below":200},...}
# balance = available + reserved, never negative; reserved = estimated fees of open invoices paid with credits.

curl https://api.coinvello.com/v1/credits/bundles -H "Authorization: Bearer $COINVELLO_API_KEY"
# list of CreditBundle: id, name, credits, bonus_credits, price {amount,currency:"USD"}, price_per_credit,
# crypto_prices[] {asset, amount, rate}, rates_as_of

curl https://api.coinvello.com/v1/credits/purchases \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $COINVELLO_API_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"bundle_id":"bnd_growth_15000","pay_asset":"usdt","pay_chain":"tron"}'
# CreditPurchase: id cpu_..., status (invoice lifecycle), credits, price, checkout_url
# (https://pay.coinvello.com/credits/cpu_...), payment.payment_options[] with the operator wallet address.
```

Pay the returned payment option (or open `checkout_url`); credits are added at `paid`/`overpaid`
and `credits.added` fires. Merchants can also pay by card: cards are saved in the dashboard
(Square card form + 2FA; API keys cannot add cards), listed by `GET /credits/payment_methods`, and
charged with `POST /credits/purchases {"bundle_id":"...","payment_method":"pm_..."}`, which returns
`paid` at once or `402 card_error / card_declined`. `GET /credits/ledger` lists every debit and
credit (`reason`: invoice_fee, checkout_fee, purchase, purchase_reversal, bonus, ...).
`PUT /credits/auto_topup` buys a bundle with the saved card when the balance drops below a
threshold (`monthly_limit` optional; card-only, since crypto cannot be pulled).

Running out: the balance never goes below zero (no deficit, no overage). Creating an invoice paid with
credits reserves its estimated fee (`clamp(round(usd x 30 bps / $0.01), 2, 2000)`); a payment larger than
the invoice is charged at most what the account holds. When `available` cannot cover a new invoice, an
account with `auto_switch_to_pay_as_you_go: true` (the default; `PATCH /account` to change it) switches to
`billing_plan: "pay_as_you_go"` and keeps taking payments, and the account email is notified (only where
pay as you go is open to the account, `pay_as_you_go.available`). Otherwise creating invoices returns
`402 credits_error / insufficient_credits` with `details: { available, required, bundles_url }`;
detection of already-issued invoices continues. Bitcoin payments use credits even on pay as you go.

Indicative bundle tiers (from the pricing model; the API is authoritative): Starter 2,500 for $25 (0.30%); Growth 15,000 for $120 (0.24%); Scale 75,000 for $450 (0.18%);
Volume 400,000 for $1,600 (0.12%); Enterprise 2M+ from $6,000 (<= 0.09%). Purchased credits last
24 months.

## 3b. Pay as you go

The alternative to credits: `PATCH /account {"billing_plan":"pay_as_you_go"}` (API key, or a dashboard session
with a 2FA step-up). CoinVello then takes 0.4% (`fee_bps: 40`) of each payment on-chain, nothing up front.
`GET /account` shows `billing_plan` and `pay_as_you_go.chains[].status` (enabled / sweep_only / disabled /
not_supported). Bitcoin keeps using credits. A prepaid account also lands here automatically when its credits
run out, unless `auto_switch_to_pay_as_you_go` is false (section 3). Still non-custodial:

- Each wallet on an enabled chain gets a **receiver** (`GET /receivers`, `rcv_...`): a merchant-owned contract
  (EVM, Tron) or program-owned vault (Solana) whose address is known before it is deployed. Invoices created afterwards set
  `payment_options[].receiver_id` and `address` to the receiver. Customers pay it with ordinary transfers;
  nothing changes for them or for your webhook handling.
- A **sweep** splits the receiver's balance on-chain: 99.6% to your wallet, 0.4% to CoinVello (or its backup
  address; if neither can take it you get 100%). Nobody can change the split or redirect funds. CoinVello's
  sweeper sweeps when the fee covers gas several times over; you can sweep any time with
  `POST /receivers/{id}/sweep_transaction {"from":"0x..."}` (returns an unsigned EIP-1559 transaction; you pay its
  gas). Every sweep is listed in `GET /sweeps` and fires `sweep.confirmed` (first one also `receiver.deployed`).
- Paid invoices show `fee: {"plan":"pay_as_you_go","bps":40,"amount":"...","asset":"usdc:base","receiver_id":"rcv_...","sweep_id":null}`;
  `sweep_id` is set when the sweep that collected it confirms. Test mode: `POST /test/simulate_sweep {"receiver_id":"rcv_..."}`.

Do not hard-code receiver addresses; read them from the payment options. Do not add pay-as-you-go handling unless
the merchant asked for it: on prepaid nothing here applies.

## 3c. Contracts and safety (how to verify it)

Prepaid credits never involve a contract: payments go straight to the merchant's own wallet. Contracts exist
only for pay as you go.

- **One receiver per merchant wallet.** A contract (EVM, Tron) or a program-owned vault PDA (Solana) whose
  address commits to (factory, merchant payout wallet, `feeRecipient`, `feeRecipientBackup`, `feeBps`).
  Payers send a plain transfer. On EVM and Tron payments can arrive before deployment (counterfactual CREATE2
  address); the receiver is deployed with its first sweep (`factory.deployAndSweep`). Solana vaults need no
  deployment.
- **Sweeps are permissionless.** `sweep(token)` / `sweepNative()` / `sweepAll` (Solana: `sweep_sol` /
  `sweep_token`) can be called by anyone and send `floor(balance x 40 / 10000)` to CoinVello's fee address and the rest (99.6%) to the merchant, in one
  transaction. If the fee recipient cannot take the asset, the fee goes to the backup (`FeePaidToBackup`); if
  that fails too, the merchant gets everything (`FeeForfeited`). The merchant leg has no fallback: if it
  cannot be paid the sweep reverts and the funds stay in the receiver.
- **Nothing can be changed.** `payout`, `feeRecipient`, `feeRecipientBackup` and `feeBps` are immutable. No
  owner, admin, pause, upgrade, setter, `selfdestruct` or `delegatecall`. Solidity 0.8.24 with OpenZeppelin
  5.6.1 (SafeERC20, Math.mulDiv, ReentrancyGuard). Bitcoin has no contracts and uses credits.
- **Deployed (mainnet).**
  - EVM `CoinVelloReceiverFactory` `0x4acA19Abe7a184a81c992dcA3c0432b892C98da7`, same address on Ethereum (1),
    Base (8453), Arbitrum One (42161), OP Mainnet (10), Polygon (137), BNB Smart Chain (56) and Avalanche
    C-Chain (43114), deployed through the deterministic CREATE2 deployer `0x4e59b44847b379578588920cA78FbF26c0B4956C`.
  - Tron factory `TUGyMNRrd6DP5YLMy1P9HVqrJ9pFe4Ta2J`.
  - Solana program `2ZxRKdxZxQ1FqKYhjdCd2iZTGznaNTx1ZuAfMF7ZysMr`, upgrade authority none (immutable); program
    data sha256 `cd804af1e031b1141e608762b21233052a719785d14cd4ab9b77479db3852616` (verifiable build).
- **Fee addresses (multisigs).**
  - EVM Safe: primary `0x02FDb629Dc017D3f115D82704cE34aD8b15773aC`, backup `0x9178411cDa785999a512f60434fdDaA3E054aa15`.
  - Tron multisig: primary `TVxwn29oqnwL8ar7Ramh5htLDSnoeK2udt`, backup `TDzHd4THdZ6RU2BVq7z4mK4RGPMg7nntgt`.
  - Solana Squads: primary `CHTNf9xF8fLj7YSAFvwyyuXw43gE4Nfg6Qa2sWCDpAvA`, backup `DWJ6THXUEXmrYBFb8Tx8ZHqddwcwdHgpcEZ1TFkjw4Ac`.
- **Check it yourself.** `GET /receivers` returns each receiver's `address`, `contract.address` (factory or
  program), `fee_recipient`, `fee_recipient_backup` and `fee_bps`; compare them with the list above.
- **Audit status.** Not yet externally audited.
  Sources: `contracts/`, `solana/`, `contracts/AUDIT.md` in the repository.

## 4. Other useful endpoints

```
GET  /assets                              the assets of one mode (key's mode, else CoinVello-Livemode header,
                                          default live): id, symbol, chain, kind, contract_address,
                                          decimals, required_confirmations, min_amount, testnet, wallet_type
GET  /rates?base=USD&assets=btc:bitcoin   indicative mid-market rates
POST /rates/quotes, POST /rates/locks     binding quote / lock (attach via invoice.rate_lock_id)
GET  /payments?invoice_id=&status=&chain=&tx_hash=   and GET /payments/{id}
GET  /wallets, GET/PATCH/DELETE /wallets/{id}, GET /wallets/{id}/addresses,
     POST /wallets/{id}/verification + POST /wallets/{id}/verify (optional ownership proof)
GET  /webhooks, GET/PATCH/DELETE /webhooks/{id}, GET /webhooks/{id}/deliveries,
     POST /webhooks/{id}/deliveries/{delivery_id}/retry
GET  /events, GET /events/{id}            backfill after an outage
POST /refunds, GET /refunds/{id}, POST /refunds/{id}/submit    non-custodial: CoinVello prepares, you sign
POST /conversions/quotes, POST /conversions, POST /conversions/{id}/submit   optional swaps to stablecoins
GET  /offramp/providers, POST /offramp/accounts, POST /offramp/payouts     optional fiat via your partner account
GET  /records?occurred_gte=&occurred_lte=&type=&currency=   bookkeeping/tax book of record: one immutable row per movement
                                          (payment received, refund sent, fee, credit purchase...), valued at the time
GET  /records/summary?period_start=&period_end=   sales, received (market value), refunds, fees, net for a period
POST /exports { dataset, format: csv|xlsx|json, preset, period }   whole history or a date range; poll GET /exports/{id}
                                          or listen for export.ready; presets quickbooks|xero|koinly|cointracker|coinledger
```

## 5. Errors

HTTP status + `error.type` + `error.code`. Branch on `type` first, then `code`.

```
400 invalid_request_error   parameter_missing, parameter_invalid, parameter_unknown, amount_too_small, amount_too_large,
                            currency_unsupported, metadata_too_large
401 authentication_error    api_key_missing, api_key_invalid, api_key_revoked, api_key_expired
402 credits_error           insufficient_credits (details.available, details.required, details.bundles_url)
403 permission_error        insufficient_scope, test_mode_only, live_mode_only, merchant_suspended, ip_not_allowed
404 invalid_request_error   resource_missing
409 invalid_request_error   invalid_state, quote_expired, rate_lock_expired, rate_lock_used
409 idempotency_error       idempotency_key_reused (same key, different body), idempotency_key_in_progress (retry shortly)
422 invalid_request_error   asset_not_enabled, xpub_required, xpub_invalid, xprv_rejected, address_invalid,
                            derivation_path_invalid, signature_invalid, challenge_expired, url_insecure, destination_invalid
429 rate_limit_error        rate_limited (honour Retry-After)
5xx api_error / chain_error / partner_error   retry with backoff
```

Example:

```json
{ "error": { "type": "invalid_request_error", "code": "parameter_invalid", "message": "amount must be a decimal string",
             "param": "amount", "request_id": "req_7Hq2kLm9", "doc_url": "https://coinvello.com/docs/errors#parameter_invalid" } }
```

Retry policy: retry connection errors, `409 idempotency_key_in_progress`, `429` and `5xx` with
exponential backoff and the same `Idempotency-Key`. Do not retry 400/401/403/404/422.

## 6. Complete examples

### 6.1 curl in 60 seconds (works against the local mock too: B=http://localhost:4242/v1)

```bash
B=https://api.coinvello.com/v1; K="Authorization: Bearer $COINVELLO_API_KEY"; J="Content-Type: application/json"
# 1. webhook endpoint (store .secret)
curl -s $B/webhooks -H "$K" -H "$J" -d '{"url":"https://example.com/webhooks/coinvello","events":["*"]}'
# 2. checkout session -> send customer to .url
CS=$(curl -s $B/checkout-sessions -H "$K" -H "$J" -H "Idempotency-Key: demo-1" \
  -d '{"amount":"49.99","currency":"USD","accepted_assets":["btc:bitcoin","usdt:tron"],"order_id":"DEMO-1","success_url":"https://example.com/thanks"}')
echo "$CS"; INV=$(echo "$CS" | sed -n 's/.*"invoice_id":"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p')
# 3. simulate payment (test keys only)
curl -s $B/test/simulate_payment -H "$K" -H "$J" -d "{\"invoice_id\":\"$INV\",\"asset\":\"usdt:tron\",\"confirmations\":19}"
# 4. check
curl -s $B/invoices/$INV -H "$K"
```

### 6.2 Node (Express, no SDK)

```js
import express from "express";
import crypto from "node:crypto";

const API = process.env.COINVELLO_API_BASE ?? "https://api.coinvello.com/v1";
const KEY = process.env.COINVELLO_API_KEY;             // cv_test_... or cv_live_...
const SECRET = process.env.COINVELLO_WEBHOOK_SECRET;   // whsec_...
const app = express();

async function cv(method, path, body, idempotencyKey) {
  const res = await fetch(API + path, {
    method,
    headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${KEY}`, "Content-Type": "application/json",
               ...(idempotencyKey ? { "Idempotency-Key": idempotencyKey } : {}) },
    body: body ? JSON.stringify(body) : undefined,
  });
  const json = await res.json();
  if (!res.ok) throw Object.assign(new Error(json.error?.message ?? res.statusText), { error: json.error, status: res.status });
  return json;
}

// 1. start a payment: create a checkout session and redirect
app.post("/pay/:orderId", express.json(), async (req, res) => {
  const order = await loadOrder(req.params.orderId);               // your code
  const session = await cv("POST", "/checkout-sessions", {
    amount: order.total,                                            // decimal string, e.g. "49.99"
    currency: "USD",
    accepted_assets: ["btc:bitcoin", "eth:ethereum", "usdc:polygon", "usdt:tron"],
    order_id: order.id,
    success_url: `https://shop.example.com/orders/${order.id}/thanks`,
    cancel_url: `https://shop.example.com/orders/${order.id}`,
    metadata: { order_id: String(order.id) },
  }, `order-${order.id}-checkout`);
  await saveCheckoutSession(order.id, session.id, session.invoice_id);
  res.redirect(303, session.url);
});

// 2. webhook: raw body, verify, dedupe, fulfil on invoice.paid
app.post("/webhooks/coinvello", express.raw({ type: "application/json" }), async (req, res) => {
  let event;
  try { event = verifyCoinVelloSignature(req.body, req.get("CoinVello-Signature"), SECRET); }
  catch (e) { return res.status(400).send(`Webhook error: ${e.message}`); }
  if (await alreadyProcessed(event.id)) return res.sendStatus(200);
  const inv = event.data.object;
  switch (event.type) {
    case "invoice.paid":      await markOrderPaid(inv.order_id, inv); break;
    case "invoice.underpaid":
    case "invoice.overpaid":
    case "invoice.expired":   await flagOrder(inv.order_id, event.type); break;
  }
  await rememberProcessed(event.id);
  res.sendStatus(200);
});

function verifyCoinVelloSignature(rawBody, header, secret, toleranceSec = 300) { /* section 2.5 */ }
app.listen(3000);
```

With the SDK (`npm install @coinvello/sdk`): `import { CoinVello } from "@coinvello/sdk"; const cv = new CoinVello(KEY);`
`await cv.checkoutSessions.create({...}, { idempotencyKey })`, `cv.webhooks.constructEvent(raw, header, secret)`.

### 6.3 Python (FastAPI, no SDK)

```python
import os, hmac, hashlib, json, time
import httpx
from fastapi import FastAPI, Request, HTTPException
from fastapi.responses import RedirectResponse

API = os.environ.get("COINVELLO_API_BASE", "https://api.coinvello.com/v1")
KEY = os.environ["COINVELLO_API_KEY"]
SECRET = os.environ["COINVELLO_WEBHOOK_SECRET"]
app = FastAPI()

async def cv(method: str, path: str, body: dict | None = None, idempotency_key: str | None = None) -> dict:
    headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {KEY}", "Content-Type": "application/json"}
    if idempotency_key:
        headers["Idempotency-Key"] = idempotency_key
    async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=20) as client:
        r = await client.request(method, API + path, json=body, headers=headers)
    data = r.json()
    if r.status_code >= 400:
        raise HTTPException(502, data.get("error", {}).get("message", "CoinVello error"))
    return data

@app.post("/pay/{order_id}")
async def pay(order_id: str):
    order = load_order(order_id)  # your code; order["total"] is a decimal string like "49.99"
    session = await cv("POST", "/checkout-sessions", {
        "amount": order["total"], "currency": "USD",
        "accepted_assets": ["btc:bitcoin", "eth:ethereum", "usdc:polygon", "usdt:tron"],
        "order_id": order_id,
        "success_url": f"https://shop.example.com/orders/{order_id}/thanks",
        "cancel_url": f"https://shop.example.com/orders/{order_id}",
        "metadata": {"order_id": order_id},
    }, idempotency_key=f"order-{order_id}-checkout")
    save_checkout_session(order_id, session["id"], session["invoice_id"])
    return RedirectResponse(session["url"], status_code=303)

@app.post("/webhooks/coinvello")
async def webhook(request: Request):
    raw = await request.body()
    try:
        event = verify_coinvello_signature(raw, request.headers.get("CoinVello-Signature", ""), SECRET)
    except ValueError as e:
        raise HTTPException(400, str(e))
    if already_processed(event["id"]):
        return {"ok": True}
    inv = event["data"]["object"]
    if event["type"] == "invoice.paid":
        mark_order_paid(inv["order_id"], inv)
    elif event["type"] in ("invoice.underpaid", "invoice.overpaid", "invoice.expired"):
        flag_order(inv["order_id"], event["type"])
    remember_processed(event["id"])
    return {"ok": True}

def verify_coinvello_signature(raw_body: bytes, header: str, secret: str, tolerance: int = 300) -> dict:
    ...  # section 2.5
```

With the SDK (`pip install https://coinvello.com/downloads/sdk/coinvello-0.1.0-py3-none-any.whl`): `from coinvello import CoinVello; cv = CoinVello(KEY)`; `cv.checkout_sessions.create({...}, idempotency_key=...)`;
`coinvello.Webhooks.construct_event(raw, header, secret)`.

### 6.4 PHP (plain; same logic applies to Laravel / WordPress)

```php
<?php
// pay.php - create a checkout session and redirect
$api = getenv('COINVELLO_API_BASE') ?: 'https://api.coinvello.com/v1';
$key = getenv('COINVELLO_API_KEY');

function cv_request(string $method, string $path, ?array $body = null, ?string $idem = null): array {
    global $api, $key;
    $headers = ['Authorization: Bearer ' . $key, 'Content-Type: application/json'];
    if ($idem) { $headers[] = 'Idempotency-Key: ' . $idem; }
    $ch = curl_init($api . $path);
    curl_setopt_array($ch, [
        CURLOPT_CUSTOMREQUEST => $method, CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER => $headers, CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER => true,
        CURLOPT_POSTFIELDS => $body === null ? null : json_encode($body), CURLOPT_TIMEOUT => 20,
    ]);
    $raw = curl_exec($ch); $status = curl_getinfo($ch, CURLINFO_RESPONSE_CODE); curl_close($ch);
    $json = json_decode((string) $raw, true) ?? [];
    if ($status >= 400) { throw new RuntimeException($json['error']['message'] ?? 'CoinVello error', $status); }
    return $json;
}

$order = load_order($_GET['order_id']);                 // your code
$session = cv_request('POST', '/checkout-sessions', [
    'amount'          => $order['total'],               // decimal string "49.99"
    'currency'        => 'USD',
    'accepted_assets' => ['btc:bitcoin', 'eth:ethereum', 'usdc:polygon', 'usdt:tron'],
    'order_id'        => (string) $order['id'],
    'success_url'     => 'https://shop.example.com/orders/' . $order['id'] . '/thanks',
    'cancel_url'      => 'https://shop.example.com/orders/' . $order['id'],
    'metadata'        => ['order_id' => (string) $order['id']],
], 'order-' . $order['id'] . '-checkout');
save_checkout_session($order['id'], $session['id'], $session['invoice_id']);
header('Location: ' . $session['url'], true, 303);
exit;
```

```php
<?php
// webhook.php - raw body, verify (function from section 2.5), dedupe, fulfil
$raw    = file_get_contents('php://input');            // never $_POST
$header = $_SERVER['HTTP_COINVELLO_SIGNATURE'] ?? '';
try {
    $event = coinvello_verify($raw, $header, getenv('COINVELLO_WEBHOOK_SECRET'));
} catch (Throwable $e) {
    http_response_code(400); exit('Webhook error: ' . $e->getMessage());
}
if (already_processed($event['id'])) { http_response_code(200); exit; }
$inv = $event['data']['object'];
if ($event['type'] === 'invoice.paid') {
    mark_order_paid($inv['order_id'], $inv);
} elseif (in_array($event['type'], ['invoice.underpaid', 'invoice.overpaid', 'invoice.expired'], true)) {
    flag_order($inv['order_id'], $event['type']);
}
remember_processed($event['id']);
http_response_code(200);
```

With the SDK (`composer config repositories.coinvello composer https://coinvello.com/composer && composer require coinvello/sdk`): `$cv = new \CoinVello\Sdk\Client($key);`
`$cv->checkoutSessions->create([...], ['idempotency_key' => ...]);` `\CoinVello\Sdk\Webhooks::constructEvent($raw, $header, $secret)`.

## 7. Embedded checkout and plugins (when not to write API code)

- **Embeddable widget** `@coinvello/checkout`: your server creates the session; the browser calls
  `CoinVelloCheckout.redirect(sessionId)`, `.open(sessionId)` (modal) or `.mount(el, sessionId)`
  (inline), or uses `<coinvello-pay-button session="cs_...">`. The widget only needs the session id;
  it talks to the public endpoints and never sees your API key.
- **Plugins**: WooCommerce is available now (https://coinvello.com/integrations/woocommerce, zip download
  with SHA-256); Shopify is pending Shopify Payments approval; Magento 2, PrestaShop and OpenCart are in
  testing and not yet available. If the merchant runs WooCommerce, install the plugin and paste the API
  key; do not write custom code. For the others, use the API or SDKs until the plugin ships.

## 8. Go-live checklist

1. Live wallets registered with a `cv_live_` key (verification optional; for xpubs, `first_address`
   matches the wallet's first receive address).
2. Credits bought (`GET /credits/bundles`, `POST /credits/purchases`, pay the option).
3. Live webhook endpoint over HTTPS created; secret stored; handler verifies signature, dedupes on
   `event.id`, responds 2xx in < 10 s, and fulfils only on `invoice.paid`.
4. `Idempotency-Key` set on every POST; amounts are strings; API key only on the server.
5. Swap `cv_test_` for `cv_live_`. There is no account review step.
